notes: An earlier attempt of this case (started 2026-11-25T13:32Z) was abandoned and is not part of this file: its first 19.0.2 instance had not finished the image's first-start database import within the 600 s allowance while the machine was heavily loaded, so no gate B or C observation was made. Its three from-version repeats had each answered 200 and stored 2026-12-15 00:00:00; they are superseded by the repeats recorded here. The allowance was raised to 1800 s and the whole case was run again from the start.

During to-version repeat 3 one unrelated container of this lane (iu1b-n5x-app, an exploratory Vikunja instance for case N5 on another port) was running; it appears in that repeat's memory snapshot and shares nothing with the Dolibarr instance.
No hold overlapped any observation (hold records are inside each observation).
Gate C uses a second customer (Customer Y) on the same to-version instance as gate B, so the two orders are separate records; the request is otherwise the sealed correct path.
